hiraganaLessons.title: Vowels (あいうえお)
hiraganaLessons.description: The five basic vowel sounds — the foundation of every other hiragana character.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line down from top, curving left at the bottom
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke crossing through, from top-right sweeping down-left
あ.tips: Think of it as a lowercase 'a' with an extra curved tail.
あ.mnemonics: Looks like an 'a' typed in cursive with a fish hook tail.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short curved vertical line, top to bottom, slight left lean
Stroke 2: Longer curved vertical line to the right, top to bottom
い.tips: Two simple downward curves, right one taller.
い.mnemonics: Two people bowing side by side.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short curved stroke at the top, like a small roof
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve from top-right down and left, ending with a gentle flick
う.tips: Picture a small roof over a wave.
う.mnemonics: A little hat sitting on top of a smiling wave.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke from top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, dipping down, then looping up and curling back
え.tips: Practice slowly — the bottom loop should tuck under itself.
え.mnemonics: Looks like a swan bending its neck back.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line down from top, looping at the bottom
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke crossing through the top-right
お.tips: Similar to あ but with an extra floating stroke at the top right.
お.mnemonics: あ wearing a tiny hat feather.

hiraganaLessons.title: K-Row (かきくけこ)
hiraganaLessons.description: Adding the 'k' consonant to each vowel sound.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Curved horizontal stroke, left to right
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical line from top-right sweeping down and left
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke crossing the left side of stroke 2
か.tips: Looks like カ with an extra stroke — that tick makes it hiragana.
か.mnemonics: A knee bending, kicking a small ball off to the side.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Long vertical stroke from top to bottom, slightly curved
Stroke 2: Short horizontal stroke crossing the vertical, slightly angled up
Stroke 3: Longer horizontal stroke below, also crossing the vertical
Stroke 4: Small curved loop at the bottom-left of the vertical
き.tips: Two stacked horizontal lines through a vertical stroke, plus a small loop.
き.mnemonics: A key with two teeth and a loop handle.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single continuous angled stroke, starting top-left curving down to bottom-right with a slight hook
く.tips: One continuous angled stroke, like a sideways '<' sign.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short vertical line on the left, top to bottom, slightly angled
Stroke 2: Curved horizontal stroke from left to right
Stroke 3: Long curved vertical stroke from the right end of stroke 2, sweeping down-left
け.tips: Similar to か but the left stroke is short and separate.
け.mnemonics: Looks like か with its legs slightly apart.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal stroke, left to right
Stroke 2: Longer horizontal stroke below, curving slightly upward like a smile
こ.tips: Two simple horizontal strokes stacked, the bottom one curving like a smile.
こ.mnemonics: Two chopsticks with a smiling mouth underneath.

hiraganaLessons.title: S-Row (さしすせそ)
hiraganaLessons.description: Adding the 's' consonant to each vowel sound.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line down from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping left
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke crossing through the left side
さ.tips: Similar to か but the crossing stroke is positioned higher.
さ.mnemonics: A knee with a bandage wrapped higher up.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single curved stroke starting from top, looping down and curling back up with a small hook
し.tips: One smooth curved stroke — like a cursive 'i' without the dot.
し.mnemonics: A fishing hook with a curved line.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right, slightly angled up
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, dipping down, looping up, and curling into a tight spiral
す.tips: The bottom loop should curl tightly — practice the spiral motion.
す.mnemonics: A hiragana character with a curled tail like a sleeping cat.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Small horizontal tick crossing through the vertical stroke on the left side
せ.tips: Similar to さ but the crossing stroke is shorter and sits lower.
せ.mnemonics: A tree with a small branch growing out to the left.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal stroke with a small vertical hook at the end
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, looping around and crossing through the center
そ.tips: The second stroke loops around and crosses itself — like a cursive 'z'.
そ.mnemonics: A looping rollercoaster track that crosses itself.

hiraganaLessons.title: T-Row (たちつてと)
hiraganaLessons.description: Adding the 't' consonant to each vowel sound.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Short horizontal stroke crossing through the left side
Stroke 4: Small curved stroke below stroke 3, like a tiny loop
た.tips: Like か with an extra small stroke at the bottom left.
た.mnemonics: か with a tiny charm hanging off the left side.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, dipping down and looping up
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke at the bottom-right
ち.tips: The loop should be round and balanced — practice making a smooth cursive 'C' shape.
ち.mnemonics: A number '5' with a curved tail.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single curved stroke starting from the top, curving down and looping back up with a small flick
つ.tips: One smooth stroke that curves like a wave.
つ.mnemonics: A wave curling over — think of 'tsunami'.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single curved stroke starting horizontally, then dipping down and sweeping left with a slight upward flick
て.tips: Keep the initial horizontal part short, then let it curve down smoothly.
て.mnemonics: A gentle wave that rises at the end.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Long curved vertical stroke from top to bottom, curving slightly right
Stroke 2: Small curved tick at the top-right, like a hook
と.tips: Two strokes — the main vertical curve and a small tick at the top right.
と.mnemonics: A walking cane with a small grip at the top.

hiraganaLessons.title: N-Row (なにぬねの)
hiraganaLessons.description: Adding the 'n' consonant to each vowel sound.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Short diagonal stroke crossing through the top section
Stroke 4: Long curved stroke looping at the bottom, attached to stroke 3
な.tips: Similar to た but the fourth stroke loops more prominently.
な.mnemonics: た with a longer, more dramatic tail loop.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke from top to bottom
Stroke 3: Short curved stroke near the bottom, crossing through the vertical
に.tips: Think of it as a simplified version of ち with an extra crossing stroke.
に.mnemonics: A person kneeling with an arm crossing the body.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, looping down and curling up
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke at the bottom-right, like a tail
ぬ.tips: Similar to め but with a more pronounced loop and an extra tail stroke.
ぬ.mnemonics: A curled-up cat with a small tail flicking out.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke from top to bottom, slightly angled
Stroke 3: Short curved stroke crossing the upper part of stroke 2
Stroke 4: Small curved stroke near the bottom, attached to stroke 2
ね.tips: Similar to れ but with an extra crossing stroke at the top.
ね.mnemonics: れ with a hat on — an extra stroke at the top section.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single curved stroke starting from the left, looping up, crossing over, and curving down with a flick at the end
の.tips: One continuous stroke that loops and crosses itself.
の.mnemonics: A cursive 'n' that loops and crosses like a figure eight.

hiraganaLessons.title: H-Row (はひふへほ)
hiraganaLessons.description: Adding the 'h' consonant to each vowel sound.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line with a vertical hook at the end, top to bottom
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke sweeping from the right side
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke crossing the left side of stroke 1
は.tips: Like ほ but without the horizontal crossing stroke in the middle.
は.mnemonics: A stick figure with an arm raised — like waving 'ha!'

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single smooth curved stroke that starts horizontally, dips down, and arches back up with a slight flick
ひ.tips: One fluid stroke that looks like a gentle arch.
ひ.mnemonics: A smiling mouth with a curved tongue.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Short curved stroke below stroke 1
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve from the left, dipping down and curling up
Stroke 4: Small curved tail stroke at the bottom-right
ふ.tips: Four strokes — two at the top and a sweeping curve with a tail.
ふ.mnemonics: A mountain peak with a winding river at the base.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Single angled stroke with a slight curve, like a check mark — from bottom-left to top-right with a gentle dip
へ.tips: One simple stroke — like a check mark. Same as katakana ヘ.
へ.mnemonics: A check mark — same as katakana ヘ.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line with a vertical hook at the end
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke from the right side
Stroke 3: Short horizontal stroke crossing through the center
Stroke 4: Small curved stroke on the left side
ほ.tips: Like は with an extra horizontal stroke through the middle.
ほ.mnemonics: は with a belt across the middle.

hiraganaLessons.title: M-Row (まみむめも)
hiraganaLessons.description: Adding the 'm' consonant to each vowel sound.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping down and looping left
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, crossing through and looping at the bottom
ま.tips: Three strokes — the bottom loop should be wide and balanced.
ま.mnemonics: A figure with a wide skirt — think of 'mama' with a flowing dress.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke from the upper section, sweeping down and curling left
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve from the left, crossing the bottom and curling up
み.tips: Three strokes — the bottom loop wraps around gracefully.
み.mnemonics: A figure with a curved spine and a sweeping tail.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve from the bottom-left, crossing through and curling to the right
む.tips: The final stroke should wrap around to the right, like a curled tail.
む.mnemonics: A cow's tail curling to the right — 'moo' for む.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, looping up, crossing over, and curling down with a flick
め.tips: Similar to ぬ but without the final tail stroke — two strokes total.
め.mnemonics: A sleeping eye with a curved eyelid — 'me' means 'eye' in Japanese.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Longer horizontal stroke below, left to right
Stroke 3: Curved vertical stroke crossing through both horizontal lines, sweeping down-left at the bottom
も.tips: Like こ but with a vertical stroke cutting through both horizontals.
も.mnemonics: Two shelves with a pole running through them.

hiraganaLessons.title: Y-Row (やゆよ)
hiraganaLessons.description: The 'y' consonant sounds — only three characters.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical line from the right end of stroke 1, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve from the left side, looping around and crossing through
や.tips: Similar to か but with a more pronounced loop at the bottom.
や.mnemonics: か with an extra loop — like a fancy 'ya'.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short curved stroke at the top, like a small hook
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the top-right, dipping down, looping around and curling up
ゆ.tips: Two strokes — the second stroke creates a teardrop-shaped loop.
ゆ.mnemonics: A hot spring pool with steam rising — 'yu' means 'hot water'.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right, with a small hook at the end
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke sweeping down from the right side, curving left at the bottom
よ.tips: Two strokes — like a simplified version of は.
よ.mnemonics: は without the small crossing stroke — a simpler form.

hiraganaLessons.title: R-Row (らりるれろ)
hiraganaLessons.description: The 'r' consonant sounds — pronounced with a soft 'r' similar to a mix between 'r', 'l', and 'd'.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Long sweeping curve starting from the left, dipping down and curling into a loop
ら.tips: Two strokes — the second stroke forms a small loop at the bottom.
ら.mnemonics: A flag on a pole, waving to the left.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short curved vertical stroke, top to bottom, slight rightward curve
Stroke 2: Longer curved vertical stroke to the right, top to bottom, sweeping slightly left at the end
り.tips: Two simple vertical curves — similar to い but straighter.
り.mnemonics: Two parallel swords standing side by side.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical stroke from the right side, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Small curved loop at the bottom-right, like a curled tail
る.tips: Three strokes — the final loop should curl to the right like a pig's tail.
る.mnemonics: A curled pig's tail at the bottom right.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Long curved vertical stroke from top to bottom
Stroke 3: Small curved stroke near the bottom, like a short tail
れ.tips: Similar to ね but without the extra crossing stroke at the top.
れ.mnemonics: ね without the hat — a simpler form with just the tail.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Longer horizontal line below, left to right, with a slight upward curve
ろ.tips: Two horizontal strokes — like こ but the bottom stroke curves up slightly.
ろ.mnemonics: Two stacked shelves — slightly wider than こ.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical stroke from the right side, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve from the left, looping around and crossing through
わ.tips: Similar to ね but the loop at the bottom is more open and rounded.
わ.mnemonics: ね with a wider, more open bottom loop — like a wide smile.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short horizontal line, left to right
Stroke 2: Curved vertical stroke from the right side, sweeping down-left
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve from the bottom, looping around to the right and crossing through
を.tips: Three strokes — the final loop wraps around to the right more than わ.
を.mnemonics: わ with a more dramatic loop that wraps further to the right.

writingPattern: Stroke 1: Short diagonal stroke, top-right to bottom-left
Stroke 2: Short curved stroke in the middle
Stroke 3: Long sweeping curve starting from the bottom-left, looping around and curling up
ん.tips: Three strokes — the final stroke creates a gentle loop like a soft 'n' sound.
ん.mnemonics: A cursive 'n' with a small loop at the bottom.
